analysis.summary: An informational webpage listing ten Yosemite Valley day-hike trails or trail groups, with difficulty ratings, distances, and elevation gains. It also describes a free year-round valley shuttle and lists ranger hiking videos. The source was last updated November 25, 2024; it is not a research study, and current trail or shuttle conditions are not established by the saved text.
keyFindings: Bridalveil Fall Trail, Lower Yosemite Fall Trail, and Cook's Meadow Loop are rated easy, with listed distances of 0.5 to 1 mile.
Mirror Lake has a 2-mile lake-and-back option and a 5-mile full loop, rated easy to moderate.
The Valley Loop Trail is rated moderate and mostly flat, with a 6.5-mile half loop and a 13-mile full loop.
Vernal Fall and Nevada Fall Trails and Yosemite Falls Trail offer routes rated moderate to strenuous, with differing distances and elevation gains.
Snow Creek, Four Mile, and Half Dome trails are rated strenuous. Half Dome has the greatest listed elevation gain, at 4,800 feet.
The page states that the free Yosemite Valley shuttle operates year-round and accesses trailheads throughout the valley.
limitations: No research methods, empirical evaluation, or supporting references are provided in the saved text.
Difficulty ratings are descriptive; their criteria and applicability to individual hikers are not explained.
Distances use different conventions, including round trip, entire loop, and one way, so direct comparisons require care.
The listed Yosemite Falls elevation conversion of 1,000 feet to 328 meters appears inconsistent; the source values have not been independently verified.
Current closures, trail conditions, shuttle schedules, and permit requirements are not provided.
Safety guidance and videos are referenced, but their substantive contents are not included.
The last-updated date does not establish that the information remains current.

claims.text: Bridalveil Fall Trail is an easy 0.5-mile round trip with 80 feet of elevation gain.
claims.evidence: The trail table lists Easy, 0.5 mi / 0.8 km (round trip), and 80 ft / 24 m.

claims.text: Cook's Meadow Loop is an easy, flat, 1-mile loop.
claims.evidence: The table lists Easy, 1 mi / 1.6 km (entire loop), and Flat.

claims.text: Four Mile Trail is strenuous and measures 4.8 miles one way, with 3,200 feet of elevation gain.
claims.evidence: The table lists Strenuous, 4.8 mi / 7.7 km (one way), and 3200 ft / 975 m.

claims.text: Half Dome Trail is strenuous, with a 14–16.4-mile round trip and 4,800 feet of elevation gain.
claims.evidence: The table lists Strenuous, 14 mi–16.4 mi / 22.4 km–26.2 km (round trip), and 4800 ft / 1475 m.

claims.text: A free Yosemite Valley shuttle operates year-round and accesses valley trailheads.

Provides context for distinguishing short, low-elevation routes from longer, steeper routes.
Identifies transportation information and supplemental hiking videos, without supplying their full details.
